notes: Sources: (1) 'Cowboys All-Time Leaders' tables, pdf p247-248 (printed pages 246-247; printed rank numbers, a blank rank = tie): rushing (15 rows), receiving (15), passing by RATING (6 qualifiers, min. 1,500 att.), interceptions (15 + a tie), tackles (16 + a tie), sacks (15). (2) 'Cowboys Individual Records', pdf p263-272 (printed pages 262-271): top 3 per Career/Season/Game (ties extend it), no rank numbers. pdf page = printed page + 1 in this guide. Every digit was read from 250-400 dpi crops of the page pictures.

Passing: the All-Time Leaders passing table is ranked by rating, so its yards/TD numbers are kind=column entries; the Individual Records pages ALSO print exact-stat lists (passing yards and TD passes, top 3), so career pass_yds and pass_td each have TWO entries: the exact-stat top-3 'list' first, then the 6-row 'column' (the rating table, only 6 qualifiers). The same two-entry pattern holds for career rush_td, rec and rec_td (exact top 3 from Individual Records, plus the TD/REC. column of the yards-ranked All-Time tables, 15 rows each). Season and game scopes have one 'list' each.

Guide inconsistency (kept as printed): career rushing TDs for Ezekiel Elliott are 68 with years '2016-22' on the Individual Records page (p265) but 71 with years '2016-22, 2024' on the All-Time Leaders page (p247; his total TDs line on p263 also uses '2016-22, 2024 (71-r, 12-rec.)'). The Individual Records line apparently excludes the 2024 stint; the rushing-yards line on the same page (8,488, '2016-2022, 2024') includes it.

Regular season: the guide keeps PLAYOFF RECORDS on separate pages (Individual Playoff Records start on pdf p293); the 'Individual Records' header notes the schedule lengths (1960 12 games, 1961-77 14, 1978-2020 16, 2021-25 17). No postseason rows are mixed in.

through_season is 2025: the pages include 2025 marks (Dak Prescott 4,552 passing yards in 2025, 'Dak Prescott, 2016-25' career spans, game lines dated 11/17/25 and 12/4/25 on the same pages) and the guide is the 2026 edition dated 2026-07-28.

Names are printed 'Last, First' on the All-Time Leaders page; stored as 'First Last' (Emmitt Smith, Billy Joe DuPree, DeMarcus Ware). Years are as printed (the All-Time tackles table prints short end years like 1992-03, 1997-04, 1999-05; the sacks table prints 1998-08).

Game lists: the printed dates have 2-digit years (for example 10/23/11); 'years' holds the date with a 4-digit year (60-99 -> 19xx, 00-25 -> 20xx, since the franchise began in 1960) followed by the printed opponent text; 'raw' keeps the printed text unchanged.

Aggregate lines (no per-game list printed): game pass_td ('5 11 times, last Dak Prescott, @ Philadelphia, 1/8/22'), the third line of game rec_td ('3 16 times, last by Michael Gallup, vs. Washington 12/29/19') and the third line of game sacks ('4.0 Nine times, last by DeMarcus Ware, @ Philadelphia, 10/30/11'). Each is entered as one row flagged tie=true: a real printed game, but NOT the whole set of tied holders. (A fourth, 'Many times, last by Jahmyr Gibbs' 3 rushing TDs, belongs to the 'Game, Opponent' block = opposing players, and was ignored.)

'Season, Rookie', 'Game, Rookie', 'Game, Opponent' and 'Most Seasons Leading Team' blocks were ignored on purpose; only the Career/Season/Game blocks were used. The 'Game, Opponent' lines (for example Aaron Jones 4 rushing TDs, Calvin Johnson 329 receiving yards) are opposing players.

Tackles: the guide prints COMBINED TACKLES (and a separate SOLO TACKLES block, not used) in the Individual Records, and a TACKLES table in All-Time Leaders; both carry the footnote '* Tackles are based off of coaching film', so they are unofficial counts. Sacks carry the footnote '*Sacks did not become an official stat until 1982', so pre-1982 sacks (for example Harvey Martin 1977, Bob Lilly 1966) are unofficial.
Season pass_td prints four rows because the second rank is a tie at 36 (37, 36, 36, 34); season int prints 11, 11, 10 (rank 3 is Mel Renfro).
The IA OCR text of pdf p247 misreads several digits (for example Elliott 'got' for 99t); all numbers were taken from the rendered pictures, not from the OCR.
